citations.title: White-Box Tuning for Better Data Processing

reception: External reception came mostly from the approximate-computing literature, which absorbed it as an example. Mittal's survey of approximate computing places it among language-level approaches, a Proceedings of the IEEE retrospective does the same, and the Wang and O'Boyle survey of machine learning in compiler optimization lists its evolutionary search. Systems papers such as Paraprox position their own approximation schemes against its compile-time autotuning, and a smaller band reuses its benchmarks, the canary-input work on dynamically steered approximation among them. Nearly all of these citations are peripheral: the paper is a fixture of related-work sections on trading accuracy for performance, and only EMEURO, an accelerator-generation framework, built on the system directly. The PetaBricks compiler and language are preserved in the petabricks/petabricks repository.
